QCoh on an algebraic stack
standard_prerequisites.use: Colimit commutation of the inclusion; fp modules are qc.

core_obligations: Quote the equality as the special case of the Modules on Sites fp-colimit lemma; reduce to checking hypothesis (2)(c) of the sites remark for B = affine-scheme objects of X_fppf (proof lines 2748-2760).
Verify (2)(a): qc gives surjective smooth x: U -> X with U affine and h_x^# -> * surjective (proof lines 2761-2766).
Verify (2)(b): fppf coverings refine to finite affine fppf coverings (proof lines 2767-2770).
Verify (2)(c): the product sheaf is the sheaf of the algebraic space W = U x_X U', quasi-compact by quasi-separatedness, surjectively covered etale by an affine U'' (proof lines 2771-2785).
Final statement: the inclusion QCoh -> Mod commutes with colimits and finitely presented modules are quasi-coherent (cited Sheaves on Stacks lemma) (proof lines 2787-2792).
proof_roadmap: Quote the module-level lemma and isolate the site hypothesis.
Verify the affine-basis conditions (2)(a)-(c) for X_fppf.
Deduce the QCoh statement from colimit commutation of the inclusion.
difficulty_reason: The displayed equality is quoted from Modules on Sites; the work is verifying the directed-colimit hypothesis (2)(c) of the sites remark for X_fppf with the affine basis: quasi-compactness gives the smooth affine cover, fppf coverings refine to finite affine ones, and the fibre-product sheaf is quasi-compact by quasi-separatedness so an affine surjective etale cover exists. The final statement uses colimit commutation of the inclusion and qc of finitely presented modules.
